rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance – nondiscrimination in tenant selection
rules.requirement: Landlords and rental agents may not discriminate in viewing or renting an apartment or in the terms and conditions of tenancy based on protected categories, including source of income (which includes Section 8 and public benefits). They may use any reasonable selection standard, such as ability to pay the rent, if it is applied equally and uniformly to all applicants.
rules.coverage_text: Real estate transactions in Cambridge, including renting an apartment; applies to landlords, sellers and rental agents.
rules.exemptions: 2-family dwellings, when the owner lives there.
rules.penalty: After hearing, the Commission may file a criminal complaint in District Court, levy civil fines of up to $300 for each violation, file a civil complaint in Superior Court seeking injunctive relief, and seek an award of damages, expenses and other relief.
rules.quoted_span: Under the law, landlords, sellers and rental agents may use any reasonable standard to determine which applicants are selected, as long as that standard is applied equally and uniformly to all applicants.
